programmes.d: Murphy learns more about his abilities when he is kidnapped by a group of outlaws; zombies attack.
A change in plans has the team re-routed to a Colorado viral lab located in a nuclear missile silo.

The group makes its way to the greenhouse where Batch 47 is being grown by Odegard.

Each member of the group reflects on the apocalypse as they finally arrive in California.
